description: Global Energy Monitor’s Latin America Energy Tracker assembles asset-level energy information across Latin America and the Caribbean. The provider describes roughly 18,000 projects in 31 countries or areas, covering fossil and renewable power, extraction, pipelines and fuel terminals. Maps connect geographic assets to referenced wiki pages; summary tables report plant capacities, project counts, pipeline lengths and fuel production by country or technology. Access is free through maps and database download controls under GEM’s default CC BY 4.0 policy unless a release states otherwise. The tracker page names March 2026, while the download catalogue labels August 2026; this release-date discrepancy remains unresolved. Export formats and a common historical observation period were not verified. A limitation is that this is a regional synthesis of technology-specific trackers, so coverage thresholds and update cycles differ and prospective capacity is not installed capacity. Simulation uses include regional energy inventories and cross-sector supply-chain scenarios. It complements data-gem-global-integrated-power-tracker, adding regional fossil-supply context. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was found. No files or maps were exported.
